---
title: "Env.Clear"
description: "Empty the entire Env store."
---

Zero-fills the entire pool. Every key is removed; every kind-specific slot is wiped. After `Clear`, all prior pointers returned by [Env.GetString](./getstring) are invalid, and [Env.Has](./has) returns `0` for any key.

## Signature

```enforce
static proto native void Clear();
```

## Behavior

The store is locked for the duration of the clear. Use between unrelated scripts to reset state. The store itself is not torn down: it is reused for subsequent writes and reads.

## Edge cases

- All prior `GetString` pointers become invalid. Do not cache a raw pointer across a `Clear`.
- The pool cap (256 entries) is unchanged after `Clear`: it is the same store, freshly emptied.

## Example

```enforce
Env.SetString("a", "x");
Env.SetString("b", "y");
Env.Clear();
Env.Has("a"); // 0
```
